data.one_liner: Flutter extensions that simplify accessing context properties and common UI helpers
data.what_it_does: Provides concise extensions for MediaQuery, Theme, Navigator, Strings, and more, reducing boilerplate when working with context. It also offers helper extensions for padding, durations, and list separation.
use_when: You want shorter syntax for context-based values like sizes, colors, and navigation
You need quick string utilities such as capitalize or mock
You want to avoid repetitive padding or duration code
avoid_when: Your project already uses a comprehensive UI framework that provides similar helpers
You prefer explicit code over extensions for readability
strengths: Reduces boilerplate and improves code readability
Wide range of extensions covering sizes, text styles, colors, navigation, strings, and utilities
Active maintenance with recent breaking changes aligned to Flutter 3.47
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.47+ and Dart 3.13, limiting older projects
Breaking changes in recent versions may need code adjustments
No code generation, purely runtime extensions
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec.yaml and import 'package:awesome_flutter_extensions/awesome_flutter_extensions.dart'; no extra permissions or build_runner needed
